info.title: Digital Wallet & Double-Entry Ledger PoC
info.description: Simulated VND only. Amounts are signed 64-bit integers, never floating point. Clients must preserve integer precision. Idempotency replays status/body and retains business errors; auth/validation failures and infrastructure rollbacks are not retained. Data is immutable after posting.
